node.statement: The hypotheses established above permit the exact external lem-hx-financing-floor, which yields P_r^+(F)+P_s^+(F)>= (1-A*l_chi)/Lambda-nu(a)-nu(b). Since l_chi<=ell, A=1/(2*ell), Lambda=(2+4*delta)/ell, and nu(a)+nu(b)<=2*delta, the right side is at least (1-1/2)/((2+4*delta)/ell)-2*delta=ell/(2*(2+4*delta))-2*delta.
